purpose: Machine-checkable record of the exact factory-boundary law after the R3 correction, so independent rereview can inspect the invariants without re-deriving them.

boundary_invariant.statement: Every minting factory requires the exact competent current owner object type, and every owner label is fixed by the factory.
boundary_invariant.gate_semantics: type(value) is expected; raises OwnerProjectionError naming both the required owner family and the offending type

factory_boundaries.note: producer_ref is still a parameter here, naming the refused owner object. That is owner evidence, not a retained-state choice, and it is out of HQ blocker F's enumerated list.
producer_ref still names the refused owner object; same reasoning as above.

receipt_dominance_law.envelope_role: AdmissionEvaluation is an execution envelope only; its duplicate fields must agree with the receipt exactly
receipt_dominance_law.blocking_refs_comparison: exact ref-key set equality, so canonical set re-ordering is not a false discrepancy while an injected or dropped ref is

requested_use_law.ADMITTED: caller requested_use must equal the receipt-declared target use exactly, else rejected
requested_use_law.nonpositive: requested_use may record the attempted use, but target_use carries the receipt value and no positive route authority is granted

closed_counterexamples: duck-typed AdmissionEvaluation around a REAL receipt -> governed route obligation
owner= override on any projection/obligation/refusal factory
producer_ref= override on the adaptive projection
real positive receipt + forged evaluation decision
real positive receipt + forged evaluation reason
forged blocking refs inconsistent with the receipt
real NEGATIVE receipt + forged ADMITTED evaluation decision
residual_known_limitations: AdmissionEvaluation remains a plain constructible dataclass in its owning module. C1-03A cannot make that type unforgeable; it makes the receipt dominant over it and requires exact agreement, so a hand-built envelope can add no authority it did not already receive from a genuine receipt.

The two exact refusal factories still accept a caller-supplied producer_ref. It names the refused owner object rather than choosing a retained state, and HQ blocker F did not enumerate it. Flagged for rereview rather than changed unilaterally.
